### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **14** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7d82b2dab87c124d089c29933c2c83feb06431b5` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `aeedd4ec8d348878097ccf3dda259a22be338676` — the merge of head `1ead602361f139801ba3abc194c7a010215129fc` into base `7d82b2dab87c124d089c29933c2c83feb06431b5`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin aeedd4ec8d348878097ccf3dda259a22be338676 && git checkout aeedd4ec8d348878097ccf3dda259a22be338676
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7d82b2dab87c124d089c29933c2c83feb06431b5 1ead602361f139801ba3abc194c7a010215129fc && git checkout -B drift-repro 7d82b2dab87c124d089c29933c2c83feb06431b5 && git merge --no-ff 1ead602361f139801ba3abc194c7a010215129fc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7d82b2dab87c124d089c29933c2c83feb06431b5
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：driver-sql 的迁移计划里，"孤儿索引"分支遇到读不出所哈希键的影子列唯一索引（MySQL/MariaDB 长文本唯一键）时，不再提议删除，改为保留；读得出键的孤儿影子索引照旧提议删除。
2. 为什么改：读不出键就不知道删的是哪条唯一约束，`os migrate apply --allow-destructive` 会把它删掉，数据静默失去约束。加宽分支（#32356）和重定义分支早已这样处理，只差孤儿分支。
3. 风险与回滚：只把一条"提议删除"变成"保留"，不新增任何操作；代价是这种索引不再出现在计划里（少一条发现，不丢约束）。回滚即还原本 PR。
4. 先看：`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts` 中 `diffManagedIndexes` 第 3 段新加的一行守卫。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-13015-shadow-carried-index-drift.test.ts`，预期全过（无 MySQL 时两个实库单元具名跳过）。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地（非 BREAKING、非受管面、200 行）。

席位意见：ACCEPT。一行守卫与重定义分支逐字相同，`!p.shadowKey` 半边保住读得出键的孤儿仍被删除；实库 MySQL 8.0 前后对照与消融都在报告里。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:server#2 · head `1ead602361f139801ba3abc194c7a010215129fc` · 2026-11-11T20:07Z

- **形态:** 3 files (+200/−0) via `get_files`: `schema-drift.ts` +10 (orphan arm only), one test file +180, one changeset (`@objectstack/driver-sql` patch). Inside the claimed surface (6795926447). Not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 32430`: no governed path, 200 ≤ 3000). No `merge=os-regen` path. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay); report `mcp_calls` read-only.
- **前提实测:** the guard sits after `isRuntimeManagedIndex` and before the orphan entry is built in section 3; it is byte-identical to the redefinition arm's guard on `origin/main`. Report 6806072514 records the live MySQL 8.0.46 before/after (unreadable carrier offered and dropped by `apply --allow-destructive` before; kept after) and the ablation (3 red, controls green).
- **门禁 check-runs:** head `1ead6023`: 35 success, 16 skipped, 0 failure/pending; `mergeable_state: clean`.
- **接受的偏差:** open question answered A: "kept and reported" is read as the widening arm's answer after #32356 (kept, nothing offered); no arm reports an unresolved carrier today, and a report-only drift kind would be new surface with no pull. `Clause-②: no` accepted: planner output withdraws one opt-in destructive step the `isHashShadowCarrier` contract already forbids; no accept set or public surface moves, so no contract-review-tier review is owed.
- **范围外去向:** report-only drift kind for unresolved carriers → dropped — no consumer asks for it. Overlap with open PR #32306 (section 1, widening arm): disjoint hunks, second to merge takes `origin/main`. `Skills-docs: none` (grep in PR body, 1 hit stays true).
- **落地条款:** `Fixes #32399`; not BREAKING; seat lands: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` after this record.

## Re-queue receipt · 2026-11-11T21:02Z

Dequeued `CI_FAILURE` at 2026-11-11T21:01Z. Signature, read from the queue's `merge_group` runs on `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-32430-14754c70…`: every finished job is `success` (Governed Surface Guard, Spec Liveness Check, PR-Body Guards, all 14 Lint & Type Check legs); the one red run, Lint & Type Check 43093974725, failed only because its `TypeScript Type Check` job 130782071656 never left `queued` (started_at 20:21Z, no runner, no log), and `CI` 43093974637 is also still `queued`. No step of this PR's code failed. Same head `1ead6023` (all 51 PR checks green). Re-queued once; a second kick stops re-queueing and goes back to diagnosis.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [43093974637](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/43093974637) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Build Core](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/43093974637/job/130778240911)** — 失败步骤: Upload build artifacts（日志不可读，点进 job 看）
- **[Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/43093974637/job/130778240985)** — 失败步骤: Publish this shard's attestation（日志不可读，点进 job 看）

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
> 穿着 `AssertionError` 外衣的时间测量，仍然是时间测量。（⛔ 这只改「怎么读一次红」，不改「哪些测试可以重排」——后者由别处管。）

**跨 PR 相同签名（24h，按失败测试文件聚合）：**

- ⚠️ **本次没有可用的聚合签名**（日志里没有能解析出测试文件名的 FAIL 行）—— 这不是「没有同签名的其他 PR」，是**这一轮没测到**。跨 PR 聚合本次不可用，请手工比对其他 PR 的同类评论。
- ⚠️ 24h 评论账本**没读完**（超过 5 页仍未读到窗口尽头），所以上面的「不同 PR 数」是**下界**，不是全量。

**历史信号：**
- 本 PR 过去 24h 无队列失败记录（首次）。
- 过去 24h 队列共有 5 个失败构建（不含本次）。

**分诊清单：**
1. 失败测试在本 PR 改动的包里 → 真回归，修 PR。
2. 失败测试与本 PR 无关 → 看上面的「跨 PR 相同签名」；已有汇总 issue ⇒ flaky/环境问题实锤，去那张 issue 上谈，修好前重排只会再烧一轮全队列。
3. 两者都不是 → 可能与同组 PR 语义冲突；等前面的 PR 落地或失败出队后再重排一次即可，不要连续重排。
